title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description: We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist with 3–4 years of hands-on experience in developing and implementing digital marketing strategies. The candidate should have strong knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, content optimization, and lead generation. The ideal candidate should be capable of improving website rankings, increasing organic traffic, generating quality leads, and managing digital marketing campaigns. Key Responsibilities 1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Develop and implement effective SEO strategies to improve website rankings. Perform keyword research and competitor analysis. Develop strategies for brand awareness, engagement, and lead generation. Create and manage email marketing campaigns. Optimize campaigns to improve ROI and conversion rates. 3. Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports. Identify opportunities to improve campaign results. 4. Content & Website Optimization Coordinate with content writers and website developers. Optimize website pages, blogs, and landing pages for SEO. Conduct content gap analysis. Implement SEO best practices for website improvements. Required Skills 3–4 years of hands-on experience in SEO and Digital Marketing. Strong knowledge of On-page, Off-page, and Technical SEO. Experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console. Knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads. Expertise in keyword research and competitor analysis. Familiarity with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or similar SEO tools. Knowledge of WordPress and website optimization. Good communication, analytical, and reporting skills. Qualification Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, IT, or a related field. Relevant certifications in SEO or Digital Marketing are an advantage. Performance Expectations (KPIs) Improvement in organic website traffic. Growth in keyword rankings. Quality backlink acquisition. Increase in website enquiries and lead generation. Improvement in paid campaign performance and ROI. Timely submission of SEO and digital marketing reports. Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. Are you interested in driving forward the digitalization of operations at BASF on a global level? Then you are exactly right in our Daily Operations Solutions Team: You support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of digital solutions within the production domain of BASF’s Operations Platform by understanding business needs and translating them into solution-oriented requirements. In close collaboration with internal customers, specialist departments and development teams, you contribute to the successful delivery of global digitalization initiatives by applying agile ways of working and structured feedback cycles. As part of a multidisciplinary team, you support different solution-related activities across the product lifecycle, including: Requirements engineering and documentation of business needs Preparation and execution of system, integration and user acceptance testing Development and maintenance of user documentation, handbooks and training materials Supporting implementation and rollout activities in BASF production facilities Driving operational topics forward in alignment with relevant stakeholders Supporting backlog preparation and solution refinement Ensuring transparency on progress and implementation status You take over responsibilities in agile working environments, including facilitating coordination between stakeholders, supporting agile ceremonies and contributing to continuous improvement of team collaboration and delivery processes. During implementation and rollout phases, you support the commissioning and ongoing service of digital solutions in production environments by ensuring alignment between business requirements and technical realization. Being part of a global and multicultural team, you actively contribute in a self-organized manner to ensure that operational challenges are translated into effective digital solutions supporting plant personnel in their daily tasks. Strong communication skills in English as well as a proactive and structured working style enable you to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, business groups and user communities in a global context. Your analytical mindset and ability to connect input from different sources allow you to support the translation of operational challenges into sustainable digital solutions. You are motivated to actively drive topics forward, promote collaboration across teams and contribute to the successful implementation and adoption of digital solutions in operations. What We Offer Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

title: DOM Specialist
description: Job title: DOM Specialist Location: Hyderabad About The Job Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability & interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health. The People Services Tech Solutions team is a team of experts that helps Operations through global technologies such as Workday, I Learn. As part of the Document Operations Management (DOM) team, you will play a key role in managing the full documentation lifecycle while also supporting global Workday Core HCM. The role combines functional expertise, technical problem-solving, and cross‑functional collaboration to ensure high-quality documentation, compliant HR processes, and smooth system operations. Main Responsibilities The DOM Specialist plays a critical role in the maintenance, development, and implementation of HR IS systems. They are also key in helping to identify automation solutions and in participating in projects at a regional/global level, either as a member or as a leader. The scope includes recruitment, hiring & onboarding, termination & offboarding, talent management & development and Your Voice surveys as well as projects as part of the Workday roadmap, Global/local Workday projects or Global/local projects connected to Workday as a source system. Provide Level 2 functional and technical support and follow through to resolution in an effective and timely manner Understand change requirements at global and regional levels and translate them into actionable process and system changes. Conduct impact and root cause analysis, manage communications, and influence decisions to align with the support model and the business strategic objectives. Initiate change requests, test and implement system updates. Liaise with key stakeholders to identify pain points and implement sustainable solutions to ensure a high level of quality for Core HR master data. Contribution to Change Management roadmap as part of support activities, local contribution to end-user user adoption and continuous feedback. Knowledge management through the team and the development of local tools to ensure a high level of support (documentation, knowledge sharing…), contribution to knowledge transfer and education of first levels of support (Employee Contact Center, P&C Partners, HR Data Management teams). Cooperate transversally to serve as a liaison between People Services and Digital to provide systems support and analysis to leverage technology solutions to meet the needs of end users of HR and non-HR systems. Work closely with the People Services People Life Cycle GPO team, as well as all stakeholders such as P&C, R&P, Talent Acquisition, Internal Control, Digital Operations, to ensure constant alignment. Work closely with the Captive Centre’s in the management of Support & Service Requests, and in identifying synergies. Ensure compliance with internal control requirements of Globally defined Model, according to People Services Global Core Model Documentation Operations (DOM) - Manage the complete documentation lifecycle including creation, maintenance, revision, conversion, and alignment across systems. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure documents meet business, compliance, and regulatory requirements. Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation across all HR processes and ensure adherence to company standards DOM System Support - Create and update documents using Doc Gen functionality. Update existing BIRT-based documents as required. Build and update text blocks and conditional logic rules. Create, update, and maintain document questionnaires. Troubleshoot issues related to calculated fields used in documents. Manage signatory roles, text updates, and configuration for electronic signature processes. Workday Functional & Technical Support In Core HR, Recruiting, Talent & Employee Lifecycle.
